data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 2,491.3m. No material gross prior-year reserve movement (2017 and earlier) is evident from the gross claims development table (aggregate prior-year movement ~= GBP 0.0m). The reported net position includes adverse prior-year development principally in Financial Lines and International Liability, and the impact of the July 2019 Ogden discount rate change, partially offset by favourable developments in other classes. Named 2019 events (Japanese Typhoons Faxai & Hagibis and Hurricane Dorian) affected the inwards reinsurance portfolio but are current-year events rather than prior-year reserve movements.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year (<=2017) movement figure was provided in a 'movement in prior year's provision' note. A gross claims development triangle was used to infer prior year development; parsing of the triangle in the source extract omitted some 2019 cells, and the narrative statements quote net movements. The computed gross prior-year movement is therefore based on the triangle as printed in the report and should be treated with moderate confidence. Ogden change is explicitly referenced in both the strategic report and technical notes and impacted discounted reserves.
